canonical_summary: Seeds are used in market gardening operations for germinating plants; specific types mentioned include white onion, red onion, chives, spinach, cabbage, and turnip. Harvesting seeds occurs when they are dry, then placed species by species in bags, stored in a dry place sheltered from outside air, humidity and heat.
